programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: The Sweet Scent of Death. 1984. Stars Dean Stockwell & Shirley Knight. A US ambassador takes his wife to a beautiful country home, but their trip quickly turns into a nightmare.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Join Caroline Munro for a sneak peek of next week's devilish tale from the Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense collection.

programme.title: Strange Experiences
programme.desc: Recalled by Peter Williams. John invites his friend over as he is becoming increasingly paranoid and fearful. A curse was placed upon him by a man who he had killed exactly one year ago...

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Some Mother's Sons. 1971. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Why is Charlie letting Budgie use a flat in the middle of Soho for six weeks, and what are Hazel's mother's plans?

programme.title: The Man Who Haunted Himself
programme.desc: 1970. Thriller. Directed by Basil Dearden. Stars Roger Moore, Hildegard Neil & Alastair Mackenzie. After recovering from a near-fatal car accident, Pelham finds his life has been turned upside-down.

programme.title: Look At Life Model Girl
programme.desc: 1969. An insight into the life of Britain's top models, with a look at the rewards of the job.

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: Bite of a Tiger. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino & Jack Flood investigate various cases of political corruption. (S1, E06)

programme.title: The David Niven Show
programme.desc: The Last Room. Stars Eduard Franz, John Hoyt & Michael Fox. British actor David Niven, introduces this 1950s US anthology series. (S1, E08)

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Son of Lafe Returns. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Conlan Carter & Donna Douglas. Lafe Crick brings his son, Dub, to Beverly Hills to try some match making between him and Elly, but Jed is suspicious.

programme.title: Harmony Lane
programme.desc: 1954. Musical Comedy. Directed by Lewis Gilbert. A Musical featurette starring Max Bygraves, The Beverly Sisters and Dora Bryan.

programme.title: Arrest Bulldog Drummond
programme.desc: 1938. Mystery. Directed by James P. Hogan. Stars John Howard, Heather Angel & H.B. Warner. Captain Drummond must act fast when he discovers the theft of a destructive invention.

programme.title: The Hi-jackers
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Director: Jim O'Connolly. Stars Anthony Booth & Jacqueline Ellis. A lorry driver meets Shirley at a cafe and offers her a lift. His truck carrying valuable whiskey is later hijacked.

programme.title: The Betrayal
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars Philip Friend, Diana Decker & Philip Saville. A pilot was betrayed by one of his fellow officers and he vows to find the traitor despite his disability.

programme.title: Scandal Sheet (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars John Derek, Donna Reed & Broderick Crawford. A newspaper editor accidentally kills his ex-wife and his protégé is assigned to investigate the story.

programme.title: Doctor In Distress
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice & Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Celebration. 1972. Stars Jean Anderson, Patrick O'Connell & Richard Easton. Jane throws a party until the unexpected arrival of Merroney who brings news of a terrible mishap.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: 24 Hours. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Robert Arden & Joy Owen. In Piccadilly, Maguire spots Caldwell, a criminal he once arrested in Canada; he has a hunch that he is up to no good and follows him.

programme.title: East of Sudan
programme.desc: 1964. Adventure. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Anthony Quayle, Sylvia Sims & Derek Fowlds. Two colonial soldiers in 19th-century Africa risk their lives to save a governess and her charge.

programme.title: A Piece of Cake
programme.desc: 1948. Comedy. Director: John Irwin. Stars Cyril Fletcher, Betty Astell, Laurence Naismith. A magical guest, who can conjure anything one can wish for, causes trouble for a writer and his wife.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A spectacular performance of Up On The Roof in this wonderful musical video from the 60s.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Pigeon Decoy/Fishing with a Dog Nobbler. 1980. Jack Hargreaves demonstrates the use of a mechanical pigeon decoy before going trout fishing with an artificial minnow called a 'dog nobbler'.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. Inside Information. Director: Montgomery Tully. Starring Ronald Adam, Basil Hendon and Colette Wilde. A murder hunt is launched after a real body is used as the 'guy' on bonfire night.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Still Waters. Stars Barry Foster, Meg Davies & Ronald Hines. A new sea barrier causes a row between senior Dutch politicians and the radical Green Party.

programme.title: I, The Jury
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Director: Harry Essex. Stars Biff Elliot, Preston Foster & Peggie Castle. Detective Mike Hammer wants to find and kill the person who shot his friend. Clues lead to a beautiful woman.

programme.title: San Ferry Ann
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Director: Jeremy Summers. Stars Wilfred Brambell, David Lodge, Joan Sims & Barbara Windsor. Sound effect comedy about the misadventures of a group of tourists on a trip to France.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: Brains. 1971. Stars Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson, Georgina Hale. Budgie's onto something big. It means 'Playing at Home' in Watford for a change and seeing his wife Jean.

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: 2000. Romance. Director: Michael Winterbottom. Stars Peter Mullan, Milla Jovovich & Wes Bentley. A man who sold his wife and daughter to get ahead in business has his past come back to haunt him.

programme.title: There Was a Young Lady
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Michael Denison, Dulcie Gray & Sydney Tafler. A diamond merchants' secretary gets fired by her new boss for being too efficient.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Saddle. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: The Strand
programme.desc: Reginald Foort is at the organ and wants you to sing a long. This song is The Strand.

programme.title: Impact (1963)
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Jack Moir (Conrad Phillips of 'William Tell' fame), a newspaper reporter, is framed by 'The Duke' (George Pastell), a Soho racketeer against whom he has written a series of articles.

programme.title: Prisoners of the Tower
programme.desc: 1946. Documentary. Directed by Cecil H. Williamson. Narrated by Valentine Dyall. A newly discovered film covering the fascinating story of The Tower of London.

programme.title: The Walking Target

programme.title: Dick Barton at Bay

programme.title: The Ghost Train

programme.title: The Card
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Director: Ronald Neame. Stars Alec Guinness, Glynis Johns & Valerie Hobson. A man finds ways to rise through the ranks in business and social standing, some honest, some not.

programme.title: Crown Court

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Getaway - Part 2. 1974. Stars Lyndon Brook, Elizabeth Weaver & Tina Heath. Fiona Sumner tells the court she initially agreed to go with McDowell but later changed her mind.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Getaway - Part 3. 1974 Stars John Flanagan, John Barron & Lyndon Brook. Son of Philip McDowell tells the court that Fiona wanted to go on the trip to visit her father who she thought was dead.
